claim.statement: The guarded Crystal CPU DINOv3 layer-0 reference matches an independently generated source-formula F32 reference at every retained boundary for a deterministic eight-token input.
claim.scope: One pinned local DINOv3 F32 checkpoint, one layer, eight tokens (one CLS, four registers, three patches), one Apple Silicon CPU process, and the block boundary only; this is not full encoder, 1024px, upstream Transformers-runtime, quality, GPU, or Metal parity.

evidence.result: fails closed before checkpoint work because the generated reference directory is absent

result.backend: independent torch CPU formulas; no Transformers DINOv3 runtime

evidence.case: model-scale block budget one multiply-add below the pinned plan
evidence.result: BlockBudgetError is raised before the forward when max_multiply_adds is 100794367

dod: The reference and Crystal loader agree on the pinned checkpoint digest, layer-0 role mapping, geometry, parameter byte count, and F32 parameter digest.
Crystal compares all 20 retained boundaries with bounded 5e-4 absolute and relative tolerance, including scores, exact GELU, residuals, block output, and extractor final norm.
The model-scale path is compile-flagged, accepts an explicit multiply-add budget, rejects one-MAC-under admission, and runs behind a 512 MiB RSS guard.
Default production compilation retains the synthetic 64/256/8 geometry envelope; full encoder, 1024px geometry, and Metal remain unrun.
Focused parity, CPU-only DINOv3/TRELLIS.2 suites, formatting, Python parsing, and the CPU-only no-codegen build pass.

excluded: latency, concurrency, quality, and cross-host numerical variance

residual_risks: The oracle uses explicit source formulas and PyTorch CPU tensors because the local Transformers DINOv3 runtime is unavailable; this is source-backed numerical parity, not runtime parity.
The measured tolerance and RSS result are one fresh-process Apple Silicon CPU comparison and may change with compiler, PyTorch, or host backend changes.
The decoder checks each tensor against a digest receipt but does not lock the checkpoint file against same-size replacement after inventory verification.
Retaining all 20 trace boundaries is diagnostic-only and is not yet a memory-efficient production execution path.
The slice does not establish full-encoder output quality, 1024px safety, Metal performance, padding/cache behavior, or production readiness.
